items.title: 独家解读丨「余粮」只剩 7 亿，Meta 为何成了最失意的 AI 巨头？
items.raw_excerpt: “Meta 已经输掉了 AI 上半场，现在它不得不换个故事讲，但目前看来还没讲圆。” 今早 Meta 二季度财报发布后，深圳某券商分析师王虹对雷峰网说道。 净利润暴跌 14 %，营业利润下滑 8%，自由现金流仅剩 7.84 亿美元，全年AI资本开支再次上调至 1350 亿~1450 亿美元……这组数据让华尔街心惊肉跳。 财报一出，Meta 股价应声下跌，盘后一度暴跌超 11%。 “主业承压、AI狂烧钱但不见回报，这是资本最忌讳的组合。”王虹补充道。 在 AI 上花出去的钱，到底怎么赚回来？成了资本市场对 Meta 的迫切拷问。 有意思的是，财报前的一个多月，Meta 动作频频：内部孵化器悄悄自研对标 OpenRouter 的模型路由器，给AI任务“降档”省钱；6 月开始，对员工的 Token 使用设限、建预算追踪平台；7 月初，又被曝正式筹建云业务部门，尝试对外出租算力。 一边是史上最激进的 AI 投入，一边是近乎“抠门”的精打细算。 矛盾吗？并不。这恰恰说明，Meta 的 AI 战争，已经从“不惜一切代价上桌”，切换到了“每一美元都要有回声”的下半场。 “大模型比拼格局初定， 下半场的主旋律是：AI 落地、利润兑现，以及把 ROI 故事讲圆。 ”王虹强调。 而这，也是 2026 年所有 AI 公司急需回答的命题。 01 那个“最不争气”的巨头 想要读懂 Meta 为什么突然急着“向 AI 要钱”，得先看清它眼下的牌面有多尴尬。 从 2023 年初 ChatGPT 引爆大模型热潮算起，差不多三年半时间过去了。同一批老牌互联网巨头里，微软抓住了 OpenAI 的先机，吃到了第一波 AI 红利；谷歌后来居上，手握 Gemini，目前稳居第一梯队；亚马逊虽无强大模型，却有全球市占率第一的 AWS 托底。 芯片、算力、模型——AI 上半场，产业链上的三张牌，各家至少都握住了一张。

Wang Hong, a securities analyst at a Shenzhen brokerage, told Leiphone.com this morning after Meta released its Q2 earnings. Net profit plunged 14%, operating profit fell 8%, free cash flow was only $784 million, and full-year AI capital expenditure was again raised to $135–145 billion… These figures sent chills through Wall Street. excerpt_i18n.en: B300 prices have tripled within six months, and a major East China manufacturer is asking suppliers to choose between two customers. B300 whole-unit prices continue to rise. According to multiple industry insiders, domestic spot quotes have surged from over 4 million yuan per unit after the Spring Festival to more than 12 million yuan per unit, with the market shifting from "a new price every week" to "a new price every day." However, amid high prices and shortages, some so-called "spot inventory" does not actually exist. According to informed sources, in at least three or four transactions they encountered, sellers claimed to have spot goods and demanded that buyers provide capital verification materials, corporate qualifications, and other information. The ultimate goal was to extract data on capital, procurement, and computing power deployment from major domestic enterprises, posing an information security risk. Competition for genuine supply is also intensifying. It is reported that a major East China manufacturer previously advancing procurement of more than 10,000 B300 units is sweeping up supply more aggressively than another leading internet company that had been actively purchasing B300. To secure its own orders, this company has also required some suppliers to prioritize shipments to it and restrict supply to the latter. Domestic inference chips are beginning to be split into separate components: AFN vendor FFN has completed tape-out, and new inference players are starting with P-cards. An industry insider revealed that a domestic AI chip company long focused on the AFN architecture has made new R&D progress, with chips for FFN/MoE already taped out, while the Attention chip is still in the design phase. Before the Attention chip matures, the company plans to first form a heterogeneous inference solution with GPUs. Another company focused on the AI inference chip track has chosen to start with Prefill first.
excerpt_i18n.es: El B300 se ha triplicado en medio año, y un gran fabricante del este de China exige a los proveedores elegir entre dos opciones. El precio de los equipos completos B300 sigue subiendo. Según han indicado varios profesionales del sector, las cotizaciones del mercado nacional al contado han pasado de más de 4 millones de yuanes por unidad tras el Festival de Primavera a superar los 12 millones de yuanes por unidad, y el mercado ha pasado de "un precio cada semana" a "un precio cada día". Sin embargo, a pesar de los precios altos y la escasez de stock, parte del llamado "stock disponible" no existe realmente. Según ha sabido una persona cercana al asunto, en al menos tres o cuatro operaciones de las que tiene constancia, los vendedores alegaban tener stock y exigían a los compradores aportar documentos de verificación de capital, información de la empresa y otros datos, con el objetivo final de obtener información sobre fondos, compras y despliegue de capacidad de cómputo de empresas importantes del país, lo que supone un riesgo para la seguridad de la información.
